 1 | // Package session keeps sign-in sessions in memory for the demo server.
 2 | package session
 3 | 
 4 | import (
 5 | 	"errors"
 6 | 	"sync"
 7 | 	"time"
 8 | )
 9 | 
10 | // ErrNotFound is returned when a session id is unknown or has expired.
11 | var ErrNotFound = errors.New("session not found")
12 | 
13 | // Session is one signed-in user.
14 | type Session struct {
15 | 	ID       string
16 | 	User     string
17 | 	Created  time.Time
18 | 	LastSeen time.Time
19 | }
20 | 
21 | // Store keeps sessions in memory. Everything is lost when the process
22 | // exits.
23 | type Store struct {
24 | 	mu       sync.RWMutex
25 | 	sessions map[string]Session
26 | 	ttl      time.Duration
27 | 	now      func() time.Time
28 | }
29 | 
30 | // NewStore returns an empty store. Sessions idle for longer than ttl
31 | // expire.
32 | func NewStore(ttl time.Duration) *Store {
33 | 	return &Store{
34 | 		sessions: map[string]Session{},
35 | 		ttl:      ttl,
36 | 		now:      time.Now,
37 | 	}
38 | }
39 | 
40 | // Create records a new session for a user.
41 | func (s *Store) Create(id string, user string) Session {
42 | 	s.mu.Lock()
43 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
44 | 	at := s.now()
45 | 	session := Session{ID: id, User: user, Created: at, LastSeen: at}
46 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
47 | 	return session
48 | }
49 | 
50 | // Get returns a live session and refreshes its last-seen time. An expired
51 | // session is dropped and reported as missing.
52 | func (s *Store) Get(id string) (Session, error) {
53 | 	s.mu.Lock()
54 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
55 | 	session, ok := s.sessions[id]
56 | 	if !ok {
57 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
58 | 	}
59 | 	if s.now().Sub(session.LastSeen) > s.ttl {
60 | 		delete(s.sessions, id)
61 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
62 | 	}
63 | 	session.LastSeen = s.now()
64 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
65 | 	return session, nil
66 | }
67 | 
68 | // Delete removes a session. Deleting an unknown id is not an error.
69 | func (s *Store) Delete(id string) {
70 | 	s.mu.Lock()
71 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
72 | 	delete(s.sessions, id)
73 | }
74 | 
75 | // Len reports how many sessions are held.
76 | func (s *Store) Len() int {
77 | 	s.mu.RLock()
78 | 	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
79 | 	return len(s.sessions)
80 | }
